desc: Prove/verify the characterization f(L,R) = #distinct − #{v : v and v+1 both present} (verified on samples 1 and 2).
Implement fast input parsing, pos[v] lists, and Term1 = Σ_i (i − prev[i])·(N − i + 1).
Implement miss(list) and precompute miss(pos[v]) for all v (T when empty).
Loop v = 1..N−1 with both lists non-empty, merge positions, accumulate T − miss(v) − miss(v+1) + miss(merged); print Term1 − total.
Verify samples and edge cases (N=1, empty position lists, sentinel gaps) — hand-verified.
Complexity check: total merged-list work ≤ 2N elements → O(N log N) overall, adequate for N = 3·10⁵.
